context: After the hosted tracker migrates to todo-db >=0.3, use standalone todo update to replace the rung with a shell sequence that resolves run_id first, resolves job_id from that run, asserts both are non-empty, then counts failures. Do not drop completed evidence or migrate the hosted DB as part of this item.
description: windows-nightly-remaining-49-failures rung 1 nests gh run view with a literal xargs placeholder inside command substitution. The shell expands it before xargs, GitHub returns 404 for the placeholder, the pipeline counts zero FAILED lines, and test 0 -lt 62 passes. Observed directly on 2026-07-29 while the latest real Windows job still had 62 failures.

preserves.behavior: the corrected rung fails on missing run, job, or log data instead of interpreting it as zero failures

verifications.command: run_id=$(gh run list --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --workflow nightly.yml --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq ".[0].databaseId"); test -n "$run_id"; job_id=$(gh run view "$run_id" --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --json jobs --jq ".jobs[]|select(.name==\"test (windows-latest, 3.10)\")|.databaseId"); test -n "$job_id"; failure_count=$(gh run view "$run_id" --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --log-failed --job "$job_id" | grep -o "FAILED tests/[^ ]*" | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d " "); test "$failure_count" -gt 0
verifications.description: Resolved run and job IDs produce a non-empty failed-test inventory

work_units.summary: Replace the vacuous rung after hosted update support is available
